hero.subtitle: Automated wound healing analysis, structured data management, and early risk detection without leaving home. Our AI platform brings expert-level skin assessment to your smartphone.

problem.title: Why Wound Care Needs a Revolution
problem.subtitle: Millions suffer from preventable complications due to limited access to consistent, high-quality dermatological care.
problem.card1Desc: Wound infections and skin complications are often detected late due to infrequent clinical monitoring and reliance on inaccurate visual self-assessments.
problem.card2Desc: Dermatology and wound care services are unevenly distributed, with rural and semi-urban areas facing major shortages of specialized healthcare professionals.
problem.card3Desc: Non-adherence to care routines and missing historical data lead to preventable complications, while existing solutions lack continuous tracking and management.

features.title: Comprehensive Care Management
features.subtitle: Our AI-powered platform provides end-to-end solutions for both immediate assessment and long-term management.
features.core1Desc: Computer vision models analyze imagery for wound size, color variation, tissue changes, and signs of infection or inflammation.
features.core2Desc: Advanced pattern matching with known skin conditions to provide early detection and severity assessment directly from smartphone photos.
features.core3Desc: Results are instantly mapped to risk categories ranging from low-risk self-care guidance to high-risk medical escalations.

users.title: Empowering Patients and Providers Alike
users.subtitle: HealDerm AI serves a critical role across the entire care continuum, from home self-management to clinical decision support.
users.user1Desc: For tracking chronic diabetic ulcers and preventing deterioration.
users.user2Desc: Remote monitoring of surgical wounds and incision sites.
users.user3Desc: Managing recurring ailments like eczema, psoriasis, or severe acne.
users.user4Desc: Empowering clinics to deliver specialist-level dermatological care.
users.user5Desc: Giving peace of mind to those managing elderly or dependent care.

footer.desc: Transforming wound care and dermatology through AI-driven continuous monitoring and structured care management.
footer.madeFor: Made for the future of healthcare.
